certs: Master NLP Practitioner, Clinical Hypnotherapy, Master Reiki, Certified Life Coach
training:
My professional training encompasses integrative healing modalities, human behavior, subconscious reprogramming, energy medicine and transformational personal development.

I received my training through Thrive Learning Center, earning certifications in Clinical Hypnotherapy, Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) and Life Coaching, including my Master NLP Practitioner certification through training affiliated with the Society of NLP.

I am a certified Usui/Holy Fire III Reiki Master Practitioner, trained by Jolene Caffrey, and have completed Level I Pranic Healing training. I am also a certified Plant Medicine Facilitator, with additional training in Somatic Breathwork and Transformational Growth.

My ongoing independent studies encompass nervous system regulation, consciousness, Natural Law, expanded perception, sacred plant medicine and the interconnectedness of mind, body and spirit.

I integrate these disciplines into a multidimensional approach to personal empowerment, spiritual development, expanded consciousness and holistic wellness.
long:
Luminate Harmonics is an integrative holistic wellness practice in Bozeman, Montana, specializing in nervous system regulation, energy medicine, expanded consciousness and personal transformation.

My approach bridges ancient healing wisdom with modern understandings of human behavior, perception and the mind-body connection. I offer Harmonic Egg sound and light wellness, Holy Fire III Reiki, somatic breathwork, clinical hypnotherapy, Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP) and Soul Development Mentorship.

I also offer education, preparation and integration support for sacred plant medicine journeys, honoring the spiritual significance of plant medicine as a potential catalyst for self-discovery, expanded awareness and personal growth.

My philosophy is rooted in the understanding that each individual possesses an innate capacity for healing and transformation. Through personalized experiences, I empower individuals to deepen their self-awareness, expand their perception, reconnect with their intuition and cultivate greater harmony within themselves.
